issues.summary: 8/16-bit integer and char increment/decrement expression value returns widened int or post-increment value
issues.avoidedShape: Pre/post increment or decrement (++ / --) on sbyte, byte, short, ushort, or char in value-consuming expression contexts; only statement-level increment/decrement is emitted when avoided.

issues.summary: Null-coalescing operator (??) between Nullable<T> of different widths or narrow Nullable<T> implicit promotion
issues.avoidedShape: Null-coalescing operator (??) where left and right operands have different underlying types or widths, or where a narrow Nullable<T> is implicitly promoted.

issues.summary: Nullable<T> local variable declarations fail C++ / CUDA transpilation or runtime lowering
issues.avoidedShape: Local variable declarations of type Nullable<T> (T?); Nullable<T> is instead exercised via struct fields on profiles C and G.

issues.summary: Instance methods of plain structs called from device code are not emitted or diagnosed
issues.avoidedShape: Calling plain struct instance methods directly from kernels; computed readonly properties and [GpuDeviceFunction] helpers are used when avoided.

issues.summary: Null-coalescing assignment (??=) used as a value has type Nullable<T> in generated C++ and does not compile
issues.avoidedShape: Null-coalescing assignment (a ??= b) used inside a value-consuming expression; only statement-level (a ??= b;) is emitted when avoided.

issues.summary: Nested tuple deconstruction and a conditional expression on the right of a deconstruction fail with GSH0003
issues.avoidedShape: Nested tuple deconstruction targets or values ((a, (b, c)) = (x, (y, z))) and conditional expressions on the right-hand side of a deconstruction ((a, b) = cond ? (x, y) : (y, z)).

issues.summary: default(T) leaves the fields of a struct with a conversion operator uninitialized on native and CUDA
issues.avoidedShape: default(T) or default literal for a struct that declares a user-defined conversion operator or contains such a struct as a field, including reducer local-declaration hoisting to default(T).

issues.summary: MSVC /Og optimizer miscompiles in generated native C++ kernels
shapes: Negation followed by division by a constant (-x / C or (0 - x) / C; Microsoft 11177375)
Zero-extension and sign-extension mix-up on a single short value (Microsoft 11127140)
Truncation to short dropped before choosing a pointer assignment target (fixed in MSVC 19.52+)
issues.removalCondition: Remove this entry once the #1078 compiler workaround is merged.
issues.avoidedShape: Negation (-x or 0 - x) used directly as the dividend of a division or remainder operation on Profile C until the #1078 workaround is merged.
